Fifty clones need fifty compressors: the node scores an hour meter, so each seat files a box serial, a pad survey and a logger calibration sheet, then streams hourly temperatures. Every trace is checked against the local weather feed, and a shell whose compressor idles flatlines and loses its seat at audit.

Used 40-footer 12,000 dollars, genset 6,500, logger 600, permafrost pad 3,000, power bond 900, near 1.15 million for fifty before one box cools.

Minus eighteen reads alike at the wharf and on the bedrock ledge; the tundra yard's meter still says which compressor ran.
